name: Valverde — night with strong wind
description: Same Valverde territory, but the fire starts at night on the west edge of the forest, with a strong westerly wind and very dry vegetation. Fewer daylight hours, later alert.

msel.title: Night call: flames on the west edge of the forest
msel.text: 02:30 – A night driver reports flames on the west edge of the North Forest, about 700 m west of Pineta. Strong wind from the west at 55 km/h, very dry vegetation. Visibility is poor and the glow is visible from the village.
msel.objective: Initial situational awareness at night; limited information

actions.title: Ignition on the west edge of the forest
actions.note: The fire starts at 02:30, as reported by inject N-01. Keep this action selected when sending the inject to start the fire.

actions.title: Night-time estimate (112)
actions.note: At night, calls give only a very uncertain position and extent.

msel.title: Residents asleep
msel.text: The caretaker of the Pineta Primary School sees the glow from his flat. The school is empty, but several families nearby are asleep and no one has been warned.
msel.objective: Warning a sleeping population; choosing between warning and evacuation

msel.title: Wind stronger than forecast
msel.text: The wind is now gusting to 70 km/h from the west. Embers are expected to carry well ahead of the front.

it.Same Valverde territory, but the fire st: Stesso territorio di Valverde, ma l'incendio parte di notte dal bordo ovest del bosco, con vento forte da ovest e vegetazione molto secca. Meno ore di luce, allerta più tardiva.
it.Ignition on the west edge of the forest: Innesco sul bordo ovest del bosco
it.The fire starts at 02:30, as reported by: Il fuoco parte alle 02:30, come segnalato dall'inject N-01. Lascia spuntata «Esegui» per far partire l'incendio.
it.At night, calls give only a very uncerta: Di notte le chiamate danno solo una posizione e un'estensione molto incerte.
